stemMd: A microorganism has membrane-bound nuclei and a cell wall containing chitin. Which group is most consistent with these observations?
explanationMd: A membrane-bound nucleus identifies a eukaryotic organism. Chitin in the cell wall is characteristic of fungi. The observations exclude prokaryotic bacteria and archaea, acellular viruses, and animals, whose cells lack a cell wall.

distractorRationale.e: Bacteria do not have membrane-bound nuclei.
distractorRationale.d: Animal cells do not have chitin cell walls.
distractorRationale.a: Viruses have no cellular nuclei or cell walls.
distractorRationale.b: Archaea are prokaryotes without membrane-bound nuclei.
